Grand Theft Auto VI Launch Updates (PS5 / Xbox Series X|S)

Below are the fixes and improvements included in recent title updates.

[November 23, 2026] - General / Miscellaneous

  • Fixed an issue where the deadlift bar could clip through the gym floor.
  • Fixed an issue that could cause the game to stop responding when loading a save.
  • Fixed an issue where some vehicle radio stations would not play after fast travel.
  • Fixed an issue where mission markers could fail to appear after a cutscene.
  • Fixed an issue that could cause audio to desync during phone calls.
  • Improved stability when switching between characters.
  • Fixed various text and localization issues.

Last updated November 23, 2026
